newsitem.title: ITALY: GOLF-OLAZABAL PLAYS DOWN RYDER CUP CHANCES.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OLAZABAL PLAYS DOWN RYDER CUP CHANCES.

text.p: Jose Maria Olazabal is determined not to get caught up in the fever over accumulating Ryder Cup points when he tees off in the Italian Open on Thursday.
I'm trying not to think about the Ryder Cup every time I play because I have plenty of other things to worry about," Olazabal said. "How my feet are feeling, for instance."
Olazabal was out of the game for 18 months with a foot injury originally diagnosed as rheumatoid arthritis but later found to be a lower back hernia.

The 1994 U.S. Masters champion reappeared on the professional tour in the Dubai Desert Classic two months ago, finishing 12th. He has since won the Turespana Masters, finished fourth in the Portuguese Open, 11th in last week's Spanish Open and 12th in the Masters.

With a prize of $470,000 and 78,330 points on offer for first place in the tournament at Gardagolf, Brescia, Olazabal can move comfortably into one of the automatic top 10 spots in the European Ryder Cup rankings.
If he can then maintain his position it will be one less wild card for Ryder Cup captain Seve Ballesteros to worry about when he makes his two selections.

Three months ago Ballesteros said he was certain Olazabal would qualify automatically but his compatriot is trying to put the Ryder Cup out of his mind for the time being. And he is not going to change his rehabilitation schedule.

"If I play well then the Ryder Cup will fall into place. I'm not changing my plan of playing for two weeks and then taking time off to rest just because of earning more Ryder Cup points -- at the moment anyway."
Three more experienced Ryder Cup men can make their marks this week at the course near Lake Garda.

Home favourite Costantino Rocca, second in the Cup rankings, will rubber-stamp his third Ryder Cup place with a victory, while Ian Woosnam, lying eighth, can book his ticket for Valderrama if he wins. Bernhard Langer can also make a big move up from 13th in the table.
